questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Orthogonal resultant R=√((3×(4))²+(4×(4))²)=5×(4)। সাধারণ যোগে 7×(4) ভুল।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Equal masses 8 kg, one at speed 4 m/s অন্য rest। stick together। lost kinetic energy কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Momentum gives final speed 2। initial K=8×(8), final K=½·2×(8)·4=4×(8)। loss=4×(8) J।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Laminar flow tube length L→4L, radius r→2r, same viscosity। hydraulic resistance ratio new/old কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Poiseuille R∝L/r⁴। ratio=(4)/(2⁴)=(4)/16; radius squared নয় fourth power।

questions.question_bn: Fixed N,V gas-এর all molecular speeds 4 গুণ হলে pressure factor কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। P=⅓(Nm/V)〈v²〉। same number density-এ mean-square speed (4)² গুণ, pressure ও (4)²।

questions.question_bn: Common-emitter switch: emitter grounded, VCC=12 V, RC=1kΩ, β=50, IB=40μA। saturation-এ VCE=0.2 V। active/saturation দুটো অবস্থা বিবেচনা করে collector current কত mA?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Active prediction Ic=βIb=0.5×(4) mA। Load সীমা Ic=(12−0.2)/1000=11.8mA। prediction এই সীমা ছাড়ালে transistor saturated; ছোট মানটি নিতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: Gas rms speed 7 গুণ করতে absolute temperature কত গুণ চাই?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। vrms=√(3RT/M)। same gas-এ v∝√T; speed factor (7) gives temperature factor (7)²।

questions.question_bn: Intensity I→100I। sound level increase কত dB?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Δβ=10log₁₀(I₂/I₁)। factor 10ᵏ হলে increase 10k dB, amplitude formula factor 20 এখানে নয়।

questions.question_bn: Planet-এর GM/R=4 J/kg। surface থেকে radius 2R-এ প্রতি kg তুলতে work কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Potential V=−GM/r। ΔV=−GM/(2R)+GM/R=GM/(2R)=(4)/2; quasistatic external work positive।

questions.question_bn: V=πr²h। r-এর maximum relative error 11%, h-এর 2%। V-এর first-order maximum error কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Product-এর maximum relative errors যোগ হয়, powers multiplier: ΔV/V≈2Δr/r+Δh/h=(2×(11)+2)%।

questions.question_bn: Coil magnetic moment μ=3 A·m², B=2T, normal makes 30° with B। torque কত N·m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Torque μBsinθ=(3)·2·½=(3)। θ normal-এর angle, plane-এর angle নয়।

questions.question_bn: Same metal/current wire cross-section A→10A। drift speed ratio new/old কত?

questions.question_bn: Same pendulum planet A period 6s,planet Bperiod 3s। gB/gA কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। T∝1/√g sameL。 gB/gA=(TA/TB)²=2²=4; period ratio inverted and squared।

questions.question_bn: Identical straight-chain alkyl halide with 17carbon undergoes ideal Wurtz coupling। major coupled alkane carbon count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Wurtz 2RX+2Na→R–R+2NaX। identical alkyl fragments eachncarbon combine to2ncarbon; mixed halides mixtures দেয়।

questions.question_bn: Same charge passes Ag⁺ ও Cu²⁺ cellsseries। depositedmoles Ag=10। Cumoles কত?

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=14 mol,H₂=28 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(14))/3,availableN₂(14) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(14)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=15, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।

questions.question_bn: Ore50g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Pure oxide 8ng; Femassfraction 112/160=0.7。 actual iron 8×(5)·0.7=5.6ng; impurityremovedfirst।

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 5mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। MnO₄⁻acidic Mn²⁺-এ 5electronaccepts। each Fe²⁺oneelectronloses⇒5Fe²⁺perpermanganate।

questions.question_bn: At fixedT Henry c=kP, dissolved gas concentration c₀ atP₀। P=18P₀ হলে concentration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Stated Henry form c=kP linear। sameT,k-এ pressure factor (18) gives concentration factor (18); alternative H conventions আলাদা হতে পারে।

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=49×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((7)²×10⁻⁹)=(7)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 48mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 12mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। HClconsumed=4×(12)−(12)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=8D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: 1800g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। 10%w/w means 100g solution-এ 10g Na Cl। salt 10×(18) g; remaining water 90×(18) g।

questions.question_bn: 17 mol monohydric alcohol excess Na-এর সঙ্গে react। H₂ produced কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। 2ROH+2Na→2RONa+H₂। alcohol:H₂=2:1; H atom pair করে gas, তাই (17)/2 mol।

questions.question_bn: Food sample 2 kg-এ preservative 14mg। mass-based concentration কত ppm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Mass ppm=mg solute/kg sample। (14) mg/2 kg=(14)/2 ppm; total food mass denominator।

questions.question_bn: 11molnon-electrolyte 500gwater-এ dissolve। molality কত mol/kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Molality=moles/solventmasskg=(11)/0.5=2×(11)। solution volume বা solution mass denominator নয়।

questions.question_bn: l=6 subshell-এ magnetic quantum number mₗ কতটি value নিতে পারে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। mₗ=−l,…,0,…,+l মোট 2l+1 value। spin multiplicity orbital count-এ multiply করা হয় না।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃→CaO+CO₂। pure CaCO₃2400g,100%conversion। Ca Oyield কত g? MCaO 56
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। CaCO₃moles=(100×(24))/100=(24)। Ca Omoles 1:1×(24),mass 56ng; CO₂44ngsupports massbalance।

questions.question_bn: Gas molar mass 170g/mol, P1atm,T300 K,R=0.082L·atm/(mol·K)। density কত g/L?

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻22M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(22)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 30×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (30)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((30)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: Cell E=0.50 V,nₑ=2,extent 22 mol reaction। F96500C/mol। ΔG কত kJ?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। ΔG=−extent·(22)ₑFE=−(22)·2·96500·0.5 J=−96.5nkJ। spontaneouspositive EnegativeG।

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=23×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((23)×10⁻²)=(1/(23))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 29mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 29। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 20 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 10 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Initial H⁺0.2×(10) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(10) mmol; excess 0.1×(10) mmol,total 3×(10) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 15L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CH₄combustionreleases 890kJ/mol; amount 13 mol,burnerefficiency 80%। useful heat কত kJ?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Totalcombustionheat 890nkJ। useful fraction 0.8⇒712nkJ; heatrelease sign separate from positive useful amount।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Air1m³-এ pollutant gas 27 cm³, sameT,P। volume ppm কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। 1m³=10⁶cm³। ppmV=((27)/10⁶)×10⁶=(27); amount volume ratio একই conditions-এ।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=5M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(5)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((5)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 15 mol simple mono aldehyde (formaldehyde নয়) excess Tollens reagent reduces। Ag produced কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Aldehyde→carboxylate oxidation 2electrons; each Ag⁺1electron নেয়। ফলে 1aldehyde→2Ag, total 2×(15) mol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: এক fat molecule-এ 25 C=C bond।1 mol fat fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Each C=C accepts 1H₂ on catalytic hydrogen at ion। প্রতি molecule ndoublebond→1 mol fat-এর জন্য (25) molH₂।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 26%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 26। Convertedmass 1000·(26)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।
